status: Fixed after data retrieval but before reading matched associations
reference: Published DNA-methylation-derived leukocyte fraction from Thorsson et al 2018 GDC PanImmune archive
purpose: Independent measurement modality for immune abundance, not histology, TLS architecture, functional exhaustion or immunotherapy response
selection: Primary tumour RNA sample type 01; one RNA sample per 12-character TCGA patient barcode, lexicographically first if duplicated. Match methylation primary tumour sample; mean repeated aliquot leukocyte estimates if multiple for same patient. No outcome-based exclusion
tests: PC1 all nine and excluding Shared84 against methylation leukocyte fraction; patient bootstrap 2000 with ranks and PCA refit; BH across these two tests. Individual scores descriptive, with BH across eight non-derived sets
coverage: Report every set; retain 80 percent measured coverage gate. No ad hoc symbol aliases
independence: Different TCGA and prospective CPTAC project membership and public identifiers; not a personal-identity linkage audit
